text.en: I think the stomach is where most actual digestion and nutrient absorption happens, since it's the organ people usually associate with 'digesting food' -- in reality, the stomach mainly begins protein digestion and mechanically churns food into a semi-liquid mixture, but the small intestine is where the great majority of actual chemical digestion happens and where essentially all nutrient absorption into the bloodstream takes place -- the stomach absorbs almost no nutrients at all.
text.et: Arvan, et magu on koht, kus toimub enamik tegelikku seedimist ja toitainete imendumist, kuna see on organ, mida inimesed tavaliselt seostavad 'toidu seedimisega' -- tegelikult alustab magu peamiselt valkude seedimist ning segab toitu mehaaniliselt poolvedelaks massiks, kuid peensool on koht, kus toimub valdav enamus tegelikust keemilisest seedimisest ja kus toimub peaaegu kogu toitainete imendumine verre -- magu ei ima peaaegu üldse toitaineid.
